title: New sugar-derived compounds as inhibitors of carbon steel against corrosion in acid solutions: experimental analyses and theoretical approaches

The study used 1H-NMR and 13C-NMR to analyze structures. MR1 and MR2 showed inhibition efficiencies of 95.3% and 94.8% at 10−3 M. Surface analysis was done via XPS and SEM.
